blocks.heading: Schedules Overview
blocks.intro: Originally, the Constitution had 8 schedules. Currently, there are 12 schedules .
bullets: T - Territories : Names of States and Union Territories and their territorial extent.
E - Emoluments : Provisions relating to the salaries, allowances, and privileges of President, Governors, Speaker, Judges, Comptroller and Auditor-General (CAG).
A - Affirmations & Oaths : Forms of Oaths or Affirmations for Union Ministers, MPs, Judges, CAG.
R - Rajya Sabha : Allocation of seats in the Rajya Sabha to the States and Union Territories.
S - Scheduled Areas : Provisions relating to the administration and control of scheduled areas and scheduled tribes.
O - Other Tribes : Administration of tribal areas in the states of **Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram** (Mnemonic: ATM-M).
F - Federal Lists : Division of powers between the Union and the States (Union List, State List, Concurrent List).
O - Official Languages : 22 languages recognized by the Constitution. (Sindhi added by 21st, Konkani/Manipuri/Nepali by 71st, Bodo/Dogri/Maithili/Santhali by 92nd).
